newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Natural Gas, TransAlta NZ seal gas deal.
newsitem.headline: Natural Gas, TransAlta NZ seal gas deal.

text.p: Natural Gas Corp said it had concluded a gas supply contract with TransAlta New Zealand which effectively opened up the New Zealand gas market to full competition.

The existing contract, dating from 1980 and involving a single delivered price for gas will continue in a modified form until no later than March 31, 1999, when it will be replaced by separate contracts for wholesale gas supply and gas transportation (transmission) services.
"The modifications to the contract include the abandonment of exclusivity provisions," Natural Gas said.
"This move effectively opens up the gas market to full competition."
Modified take-or-pay obligations continue until 1999, when they will be replaced by new supply and purchase commitments by both parties.
As a consequence of the new arrangements, Natural Gas said it had discontinued legal proceedings against Transalta under the take-or-pay provisions of the 1980 contract.

The chief executives of Natural Gas and Transalta, Richard Bentley and Gary Holden, said they were pleased a commercially negotiated conclusion had been reached and that the new arrangements suited the competition requirements of the gas market.
